**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

Section 24 sits at or above the preferred position on every material term:

- **§ 24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice + assignee assumption only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — Reasonable-consent standard for all other assignments; anti-assignment is symmetric only for the residual category.
- **§ 24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, and Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.

I also checked for stray triggers elsewhere: § 13.3 mirrors the transfer right for licences, and § 9.2 is a standard insolvency right that expressly excludes a non-impairing reorganization. Nothing in the document creates a Vendor exit or re-pricing right on our change of control.
